## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

content.text: Created file successfully: js/characters.js

Now art.js — the big one. Let's design robust code.

Functions:
- hexToRgba? use globalAlpha simpler.
- makeCharacterCanvas(char, w, h, pose='preview', time=0): creates canvas, context, draws fighter at center-bottom with scale fitting, background transparent. For portraits.
- drawFighter(ctx, char, opts)
- drawStage(ctx, stageId, w,h,time)
- drawProjectile(ctx, p, time)
- drawShockwave...

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D villains fighting game from scratch in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`, featuring the user’s large roster of villains from Halloween, Chucky, Star Wars, GoAnimate, Mario, Street Fighter, SpongeBob, Aladdin, Ren & Stimpy, Looney Tunes, Killjoy, The Witchhouse, Cyclops, Friday the 13th, Nightmare on Elm Street, Rawhead Rex, Ogre, Marvel, Gravity Falls, Donkey Kong, IT, Texas Chainsaw, Scream, Hellraiser, and Dracula.

## Requirements
- Build now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Include Michael Myers (2002-modified 1998 mask), Chucky (2004), Darth Vader, Boris Anderson, Bowser, M. Bison, Concussion Beast, Plankton, Big Baby Tom, Jafar, Ren Hoek, Elmer Fudd, Killjoy, Lilith Lafey, Cyclops, Jason Voorhees, Freddy Krueger, Big Drunk Bill, Rawhead Rex, Ogre (2008), Thanos, Bill Cipher, King K. Rool.
- “Add more villains” twice — extra fighters added: Pennywise, Leatherface, Ghostface, Pinhead, Dracula.
- Respect all specified visual details, colors, weapons, quotes/catchphrases, and special-move themes.
- Must be complete and playable, with responsive/mobile touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks; read only latest image.

## Decisions
- Vanilla JS + Canvas 2D with ES modules; no build step.
- 28-character roster, 4 procedural arenas, best-of-3 rounds, 60s timer, CPU and local 2P modes.
- All fighter art is procedural vector drawing from character data; no external image assets.
- Specials are archetype-based: `projectile`, `beam`, `dash`, `slam`, with per-character names/colors and themed effects.
- In-game HUD and announcements are drawn inside the 1280×720 canvas for consistent scaling across devices.
- Menu/select/result UI is DOM/CSS; title and roster previews use canvas.
- Plan to use Google Fonts Anton + Barlow Condensed with fallback to local fonts (no Impact/Arial Black installed).

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `js/characters.js` with all 28 fighters, stats, quotes, specials, palettes.
- Created shared canvas helpers `js/draw-utils.js`.
- Created `js/heads.js` (faces, hair, masks, headgear, extras).
- Created `js/art.js` (fighter skeleton, outfits, weapons, poses, cape/shell/tail, Bill Cipher).
- Created `js/stages.js` with 4 arenas: Haddonfield, Hellfire Carnival, Throne of Doom, Infernal Pit.
- Created `js/portraits.js` (roster cards, HUD avatars, stage chips).
- Created `js/hud.js` (health/meter/timer/round pips/combos/announcements).
- Created `js/audio.js` (WebAudio SFX + dark battle music loop).
- Created `js/fx.js` (sparks, projectiles, beams, shockwaves, flashes).
- Created `js/game.js` (physics, attacks, specials, KO, rounds, CPU AI, pause, rendering).
- Created `index.html` with title, select, fight, pause, result, and help screens.
- Created `css/style.css` with full responsive arcade-horror styling and touch controls.
- Patched `js/heads.js` to draw Freddy’s burned head base (`char.mask === 'burn'`).

### Active
- Creating `js/ui.js` — screen transitions, roster card generation, previews, selection flow, stage picker, fight startup, touch input wiring, pause/result/help overlays, sound toggles, title/select animation loops.
- After creation, must test the app in a browser, fix runtime/art errors, and capture screenshots.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Write `js/ui.js` implementing all imports/state/DOM wiring described above.
2. Start a persistent local server (prefer tmux, port 3002) and open with `playwright-cli`.
3. Run browser checks for JS errors; fix bugs in game/art/render.
4. Visually inspect title, select, fight, result, mobile layouts via small JPEG screenshots.
5. Verify controls, specials, rounds, CPU AI, touch buttons, pause/rematch flows.
6. Final polish and concise summary with assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `js/ui.js`: not yet created; main remaining file.
- `js/game.js`: fight engine, AI, rounds, input, HUD integration.
- `js/characters.js`: 28-fighter data/roster/stages.
- `js/art.js`: fighter rendering and poses.
- `js/heads.js`: faces, masks, hair; recent burn-head patch.
- `js/fx.js`: projectiles/beams/shockwaves/particles.
- `js/hud.js`: canvas HUD/announcer.
- `js/stages.js`: four procedural stages.
- `js/portraits.js`: card/HUD/result portrait canvas helpers.
- `js/audio.js`: synth SFX/music.
- `index.html`: all screen markup and touch controls.
- `css/style.css`: responsive theme/UI styling.
- `js/draw-utils.js`: shared drawing helpers.

## Important Context
- No `js/ui.js` exists yet, so `index.html` currently loads a missing module and will not boot.
- Need `showSelect`, `showTitle`, `beginFight`, `showResult`, arena grid, roster grid (`#rosterGrid`), preview (`#previewCanvas`), pause (`#pauseOverlay`), result (`#resultOverlay`), help (`#helpModal`), sound buttons, touch controls (`data-touch`), and keyboard UI navigation.
- `FightGame` constructor expects `{ canvas, p1, p2, mode, difficulty, stage, onMatchEnd, onPause, onHud }`.
- `FightGame` matches: best-of-3, first to 2 wins; `onMatchEnd` receives `{ winnerSide, winner, loser, wins, round, mode }`.
- `makeCharacterCanvas(char, w, h, opts)`, `makeHudAvatar(char)`, `makeStageChip(stage)` are exported from `js/portraits.js`.
- `STAGES` and `CHARACTERS`/`byId` are exported from `js/characters.js`.
- Current CSS hides touch controls unless `body.touch` is set by JS; UI must also detect coarse pointer/touch.
- Potential runtime issues to check:
  - `js/game.js` imports unused `GROUND_Y`; harmless.
  - `updateSpecial` slam branch calls `this.physics(f, dt)` twice in one frame; harmless but could be cleaned.
  - `drawHead` masks for Michael/Jason/etc. may show ears; optional polish.
  - `drawHud` uses canvas `Impact` font; should be updated to include `"Anton"` after fonts load for better visuals.
  - Roster card art generation uses `document.createElement('canvas')`; safe.
- Server testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`, then `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/...`; use tmux for persistent server per repo conventions.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D villains fighting game from scratch in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`, featuring the user’s requested 28-villain roster with specified visual details, weapons, quotes, and special-move themes.

## Requirements
- Build now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Include Michael Myers (2002-modified 1998 mask), Chucky (2004), Darth Vader, Boris Anderson, Bowser, M. Bison, Concussion Beast, Plankton, Big Baby Tom, Jafar, Ren Hoek, Elmer Fudd, Killjoy, Lilith Lafey, Cyclops, Jason Voorhees, Freddy Krueger, Big Drunk Bill, Rawhead Rex, Ogre (2008), Thanos, Bill Cipher, King K. Rool, Pennywise, Leatherface, Ghostface, Pinhead, Dracula.
- Respect all specified colors, weapons, quotes/catchphrases, and special-move themes.
- Must be complete and playable, with responsive/mobile touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks; read only latest image.

## Decisions
- Vanilla JS + Canvas 2D with ES modules; no build step.
- 28-character roster, 4 procedural arenas, best-of-3 rounds, 60s timer, CPU and local 2P modes.
- All fighter art is procedural vector drawing; no external image assets.
- Specials are archetype-based: `projectile`, `beam`, `dash`, `slam`.
- In-game HUD and announcements drawn inside 1280×720 canvas; menu/select/result UI is DOM/CSS.
- Use Google Fonts Anton + Barlow Condensed with local fallbacks.
- Fixed ground-coordinate bug by making fighter physics use absolute `GROUND_Y` (596) matching stage/effects rendering.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created and connected all game modules: `characters.js`, `draw-utils.js`, `heads.js`, `art.js`, `stages.js`, `portraits.js`, `hud.js`, `audio.js`, `fx.js`, `game.js`.
- Created `js/ui.js`: title/select/fight screen flow, roster cards, previews, stage picker, CPU/local modes, pause/result/help overlays, sound toggles, keyboard navigation, touch controls, rematch/change/title flows, debug hook `window.__villains`.
- Fixed invisible fighters by switching game physics/rendering/effects to absolute ground `GROUND_Y`; fixed shadows, particle floor, shockwave floor, beam/projectile heights.
- Verified jump, movement, punch/kick, special dash, projectile, beam, slam, pause/resume, actual match-end result overlay, local 2P input, rematch, sound toggle, touch movement/special, and desktop/mobile layouts.
- Added favicon, focus styling, mobile arena-list layout fix, short-name labels, difficulty label mapping, and HUD/game font fallback to Anton.
- Latest screenshots confirm title, select, fight, pause, result, help, and mobile layouts.

### Active
- Final visual polish and last verification pass; not yet committed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/28-chucky-preview.jpg`; confirm Chucky preview and roster alignment.
2. Capture/check remaining unexamined fighter previews if needed, especially Chucky, Plankton, Pennywise, Leatherface, Ghostface, Pinhead, Dracula, King K. Rool, Bill Cipher.
3. Re-test mobile portrait/landscape fight after latest CSS changes and confirm touch-controls/special-ready states.
4. Run a final console-error check (only favicon 404 was present before adding inline favicon).
5. Optionally polish Chucky’s doll face/stiches, preview portrait scale, and empty portrait/control space on mobile portrait.
6. Commit/push the finished game and summarize controls/assumptions concisely.

## Relevant Files
- `js/ui.js`: main UI/screen-flow/touch/selection implementation; most likely remaining fixes.
- `js/game.js`: fight engine, physics, AI, rounds, HUD integration; ground-coordinate fix applied.
- `js/fx.js`: projectiles/beams/shockwaves/particles; absolute `GROUND_Y` fix applied.
- `js/characters.js`: 28-character data, stats, quotes, specials, `STAGES`.
- `js/art.js`: fighter skeleton, outfits, weapons, poses.
- `js/heads.js`: faces, masks, hair, headgear, stitches.
- `js/stages.js`: four arenas and `drawTitleBackdrop`.
- `js/portraits.js`: `makeCharacterCanvas`, `makeHudAvatar`, `makeStageChip`.
- `js/hud.js`: canvas HUD/announcer.
- `js/audio.js`: WebAudio SFX/music.
- `index.html`: all screens, touch-control markup, favicon.
- `css/style.css`: responsive arcade UI, mobile arena fix, focus states.
- `screenshots/`: visual verification JPEGs.

## Important Context
- Server running in tmux session `villains` on `http://localhost:3002` via `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright browser/daemon can be flaky: screenshots occasionally time out or fail silently; retry with `--type=jpeg`, and use `--filename=screenshots/...` (some files saved to repo root when path omitted).
- `showSelect()` does not destroy an existing `FightGame`; normal UI uses `exitFight()` first. Debug calls should destroy game manually to avoid multiple active rAF loops.

- Touch detection sets `body.touch` for coarse pointer / touch devices; touch controls drive P1 only.
- `makeCharacterCanvas` caches static renders; preview/title loops animate independently and are throttled.

<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Roster preview</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; background: #0a070d; color: #f4eddc; font-family: Impact, sans-serif; }
  canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="sheet"></canvas>
<script type="module">
import { CHARACTERS } from './js/characters.js';
import { drawFighter } from './js/art.js';
import { drawFighterShadow } from './js/draw-utils.js';
const cols = 7, rows = 4, cw = 240, ch = 300;
const cv = document.getElementById('sheet');
const dpr = 1;
cv.width = cols * cw * dpr;
cv.height = rows * ch * dpr;
const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
for (let i = 0; i < CHARACTERS.length; i++) {
  const char = CHARACTERS[i];
  const x = (i % cols) * cw;
  const y = Math.floor(i / cols) * ch;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + ch);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#151019');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#08060b');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, cw, ch);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,212,71,.1)';
  ctx.strokeRect(x + 1, y + 1, cw - 2, ch - 2);
  const s = (ch * 0.62) / (215 * (char.scale || 1));
  const z = (char.scale || 1) * s;
  const scale = s;
  const baseY = y + ch - 52;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x + cw / 2, baseY);
  const sh = (char.scale || 1) * 1;
  drawFighterShadow(ctx, char, 0, 0, scale, 0.4);
  drawFighter(ctx, char, {
    x: 0, y: 0, facing: 1, pose: 'idle', time: 1.2 + i * 0.17,
    scale, alpha: 1,
  });
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f4eddc';
  ctx.font = '20px Impact, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(char.name, x + cw / 2, y + ch - 28);
  ctx.fillStyle = char.special.color || '#ffd447';
  ctx.font = '13px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0') + ' · ' + char.origin, x + cw / 2, y + ch - 10);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
